authorInfo.bio: Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth (1819–1899) wrote Capitola the madcap. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.

description: "The Lost Lady of Lone" by Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. The story unfolds in the picturesque Highlands of Scotland, focusing on the intertwining fates of a noble family and a humble shepherdess.
